notes: DiscoFlate v3.85.1 — 🩹 Fixes the Scenes tab layout that v3.85.0 broke. The two lists moved beside the canvas into a column too narrow for them: the group-controls row was pinned with flex-wrap:nowrap, each overlay row carries nine controls, and height:100% collapsed the panes — so everything overlapped and spilled sideways. The column is fluid now (300–460px), panes stretch to the canvas height, and both the controls and the overlay rows wrap. Also: the Scenes tab's two walls of text (nearly 2,000 characters) move into Help → 🎬 Scenes, broken into sections and brought up to date. And the intro's free-text "commands allowed during the intro" allowlist is gone — a typo in it silently HELD the command rather than allowing it, and intro stages carry action blocks now, so a command_gate row does the same job with real dropdowns.
